exact_manuscript.title: Nilpotent noise and complete reverse data processing

summary: No fatal proof error found under stated hypotheses. Complete nilpotent comparison and separable MI obstruction appear valid. Specialized contribution of moderate significance; novelty remains provisional. No capacity or additivity theorem.

score.rationale: Reference-uniform sufficient theorem and separable saturation warrant a strong specialist note; short synthesis of established tools, restrictive factorization, nonsharp constants and no new operational capacity result limit significance.
score.rubric_verified_scope: Global high-ceiling anchors and separate criterion profiles verified on public page. No deterministic formula mapping this review's criteria to headline score found.

correctness_confidence.reason: Full manuscript proof reading and own exact/numerical checks; no human-independent or formal certification.

rigor.reason: Supports, zero failure flag, nontraceless directions and simultaneous asymptotic are controlled.

novelty.reason: Specific complete criterion and separable witness are defensible candidates; worldwide priority unresolved.

significance.reason: Specialized restricted comparison and obstruction; no sharp complete coefficient or capacity result.

reproducibility.reason: Supplied checker reproduced byte-for-byte; own checks retained. PDF should bind supplement explicitly.

clarity.reason: Legible and well scoped; excessive prior-audit narrative and minor terminology issues.

demonstrated_operational_scope.reason: No fixed information perfect transmission, protocol, sharp rate or capacity theorem.

mathematical_findings.arbitrary_finite_R: valid, CP order and metric constants amplify
mathematical_findings.nilpotent_inverse: exact finite identity, no smallness required

remaining_substantive_objections: O1: Novelty map should compare exact hypotheses with antecedents; global priority unresolved.
O2: Restrictive sufficient factorization; no general construction or classification of qualifying pairs.
O3: Nonsharp and potentially loose constants; quantitative operational usefulness not demonstrated.
O4: MI obstruction defeats one sufficient route; it does not solve the general capacity problem.
minor_objections: O5: Clarify independence of reference dimension and joint-state nonclassicality.
O6: Move detailed previous-audit narrative to separate supplement.
O7: Bind checker to exact PDF; current checker scope still mentions PROOF914.
O8: Make pointwise-in-p nature and supremum interpretation explicit.
